description: List goals for a site with completion counts and cvr for the chosen period. period is today | yesterday | 7d | 30d | all | custom (also now, 24h, 12m, wtd, mtd, ytd). custom requires start and end as YYYY-MM-DD. On cookieless sites a multi-day cvr is a conservative floor because visitor identity rotates every UTC day. Optional filters: JSON array [{ "d": "country", "o": "is", "v": ["DE"] }]. Values OR within a dimension, AND across dimensions. Region uses country:region (e.g. US:CA). Acquisition filters select entry-session cohorts; downstream events need no UTMs. Read-only.

filters.description: Dashboard filters as JSON array, e.g. [{ "d": "country", "o": "is", "v": ["DE"] }]. Values within a dimension are OR'd; dimensions are AND'd. Region values are country:region (e.g. US:CA).

name: list_goals
